title: Identification of inhibitors for Agr quorum sensing system of Staphylococcus aureus by machine learning, pharmacophore modeling, and molecular dynamics approaches.
authors: Ramasamy, Monica; Vetrivel, Aishwarya; Venugopal, Sharulatha; Murugesan, Rajeswari
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习、药效团建模和分子动力学筛选金黄色葡萄球菌AgrA（转录因子）抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且方法可迁移，但对象偏离TF-DNA核心体系。
abstract: CONTEXT: Staphylococcus aureus is a highly pathogenic organism that is the most common cause of postoperative complications as well as severe infections like bacteremia and infective endocarditis. By mediating the formation of biofilms and the expression of virulent genes, the quorum sensing (QS) mechanism is a major contributor to the development of these diseases. By hindering its QS network, an innovative approach to avoiding this bacterial infection is taken. Targeting the AgrA of the Agr system serves as beneficial in holding the top position in the QS system cascade. METHODS: Using known AgrA inhibitors, the machine learning algorithms (artificial neural network, naive Bayes, random forest, and support vector machine) and pharmacophore model were developed. The potential lead compounds were screened against the Zinc and COCONUT databases using the best pharmacophore hypothesis. The hits were then subjected second screening process using the best machine learning model. The predicted active compounds were then reranked based on the docking score. The stability of AgrA-lead compounds was studied using molecular dynamics approaches, and an ADME profile was also carried out. Five lead compounds, namely, CNP02386963,4,5-trihydroxy-2-[(7,13,14-trihydroxy-3,10-dioxo-2,9-dioxatetracyclo[6.6.2.0(4),(16).0(11),(15)]hexadeca-1(14),4,6,8(16),11(15),12-hexaen-6-yloxy)methyl]benzoic acid, CNP0129274 4-(dimethylamino)-1,5,6,10,12,12a-hexahydroxy-6-methyl-3,11-dioxo-3,4,4a,5,5a,6,11,12a-octahydrotetracene-2-carboxamide, CNP0242717 3-Hydroxyasebotin, CNP0361624 3,4,5-trihydroxy-6-[(2,4,5,6,7-pentahydroxy-1-oxooctan-3-yl)oxy]oxane-2-carboxylic acid, and CNP0285058 2-[4,5-dihydroxy-6-(hydroxymethyl)-3-[(3,4,5-trihydroxy-6-methyloxan-2-yl)oxy]oxan-2-yl]oxy-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetonitrile were obtained using the two-step virtual screening process. The molecular dynamics study revealed that the CNP0238696 was found to be stable in the binding pocket of AgrA. ADME profiles show that this compound has two Lipinski violations and low bioavailability. Further studies should be performed to assess the anti-biofilm activity of the lead compound in vitro.
abstract_zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌是一种高致病性微生物，是术后并发症以及菌血症和感染性心内膜炎等严重感染的最常见原因。通过介导生物膜的形成和毒力基因的表达，群体感应 (quorum sensing, QS) 机制是这些疾病发展的主要促成因素。通过阻碍其QS网络，采取了一种创新方法来避免这种细菌感染。靶向Agr系统的AgrA在QS系统级联中占据顶端位置是有益的。方法：利用已知的AgrA抑制剂，开发了机器学习算法（人工神经网络、朴素贝叶斯、随机森林和支持向量机）和药效团模型。使用最佳药效团假设，针对Zinc和COCONUT数据库筛选了潜在的先导化合物。命中化合物随后使用最佳机器学习模型进行第二轮筛选。预测的活性化合物随后根据对接分数重新排序。使用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 方法研究了AgrA-先导化合物的稳定性，并进行了ADME谱分析。通过两步虚拟筛选过程，获得了五种先导化合物，即CNP02386963、4,5-三羟基-2-[(7,13,14-三羟基-3,10-二氧代-2,9-二氧杂四环[6.6.2.0(4),(16).0(11),(15)]十六碳-1(14),4,6,8(16),11(15),12-六烯-6-基氧基)甲基]苯甲酸、CNP0129274 4-(二甲氨基)-1,5,6,10,12,12a-六羟基-6-甲基-3,11-二氧代-3,4,4a,5,5a,6,11,12a-八氢四并苯-2-甲酰胺、CNP0242717 3-羟基asebotin、CNP0361624 3,4,5-三羟基-6-[(2,4,5,6,7-五羟基-1-氧代辛-3-基)氧基]氧杂环己烷-2-羧酸，以及CNP0285058 2-[4,5-二羟基-6-(羟甲基)-3-[(3,4,5-三羟基-6-甲基氧杂环己烷-2-基)氧基]氧杂环己烷-2-基]氧基-2-(4-羟基苯基)乙腈。分子动力学研究表明，CNP0238696在AgrA的结合口袋中稳定。ADME谱显示该化合物有两个Lipinski违例和低生物利用度。应进行进一步研究以评估先导化合物的体外抗生物膜活性。
